about_the_game:
Get ready for an exciting adventure in “The gold is mine”! You control a fearless miner who, after discovering a valuable gold nugget, must cross a challenging river to reach his boat and escape with his treasure.

Run, jump and dodge logs, rocks and other obstacles as you navigate through a vibrant setting full of challenges. With each jump, you'll feel the adrenaline rise, and with each level, new surprises and difficulties will arise to test your skills.

Can you overcome all the obstacles and make sure you escape with the gold? Get ready for a journey full of action and fun!

short_description: You only have one chance to make it to the end with the gold on your back. Mistakes will not be tolerated. Good luck.
